_comment: Which floor LEVEL a piece of title text names. The rule exists twice: levelOf in apps/api/src/rfiReviewRules.ts (the planner's same-level pairing, read off the title-block text) and rfi_columns.level_of in workers (the column overlay, which refuses to compare sheets of two different levels — A3.03 Level 4 against A3.05 Level 6 was reported as moved columns). Both suites read this file, so the two cannot drift.
